name: @activepieces/piece-bocha-search
description: Web search API for AI agents, providing real-time web pages, images, and news.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Bocha API Key:

1. Visit [Bocha AI Open Platform](https://open.bochaai.com) and create an account.
2. Navigate to **API KEY Management** in the dashboard.
3. Copy your API key.

freshness.description: Filter results by time range. Defaults to no limit.

summary.description: Include a text summary for each search result.

include.description: Limit search to specific domains. Separate multiple domains with | or , (max 100).

exclude.description: Exclude specific domains from search results. Separate multiple domains with | or , (max 100).

count.description: Number of results to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a Bocha web search for a query and returns matching web pages, optionally with per-result text summaries. Pick this to look up current information on the public web; results can be narrowed by freshness window, capped result count, and include/exclude domain lists (up to 100 domains each, separated by | or ,). Read-only and idempotent — repeating the same query just fetches results again.
